notes: I realized the box only capitalizes the first character of the entire string and lowercases everything else — it does not treat spaces/tabs as word boundaries. E4's `" hello world "` → `" hello world"` and `"hello "` → `"Hello"` confirm only position 0 matters, and E3's `"HELLO WORLD"` → `"Hello world"` confirms full lowercasing of the remainder.
